LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 12.3.1 WORD CLASSES: VERB ASPECT

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.3: Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LEARN

Welcome to an English program for Grade 4. Today we will learn about Present Continuous Tense.

Today, we will talk about Present Continuous Tense. Learner, what are you doing right now? What are you doing right now? - Did you say you are sitting down? - Can you say I am sitting down? - Well done Learner. That is Present Continuous Tense. Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Present continuous tense is used to show an action is still going on at the time of speaking. Present continuous tense is formed by adding is, are or am to a verb plus i-n-g. Present continuous tense is formed by adding is, are or am to a verb plus i-n-g. Examples in sentences. Number 1. Jack is washing his bicycle. Jack is washing his bicycle. Number two. I am walking to the shop. I am walking to this shop. And number three. The dogs are barking at the man. The dogs are barking at the man. Learner, can you make three sentences using is, are and a m in present, continuous tense. - Good learner. Did you make sentences like these? He is walking. He is walking. I am standing outside. I am standing outside. They are running. They are running. Learner, I want you to say the following sentences in present, continuous tense. Number 1. I download. I download. - Number two. Mary Type's. Mary Type's. - Number three. I play games. I play games. - And number four. I watch football. I watch football. - Did you get the following answers? Number one. I download In present continuous tense, I am down loading. - Number two. Mary types In present continuous tense, Mary is typing. - Number three. I play games. In present continuous tense, I am playing games. And number four, I watch football. In present, continuous tense. I'm watching football. Learner, this is your home assessment. Take out your book and write down the present continuous tense of the following words. Example, Speak. Speaking. Now, write Number one. Play. Play. - Number two. Help. Help. - Number three, sleep. Sleep. - Number four. Skip. Skip. - Number five. Run. Run. - Number six. cook. cook. - Number seven. download. Download. - And number eight. print. Print. Learner share with your parent or guardian to find out if you have written the correct tense. with the help of your parent or caregiver. find out more sentences with present continuous tense.

Your radio teacher was Joyce Agik. The program was written and produced by the It was recorded by John Mbithi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time, goodbye.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 12.3.1 Word classes: verb aspect.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER
